messages:
Sam H.: New AuroraData onboard — they completed SSO but can't see API keys in console. App getting 403 when calling /v1/generate. Can someone check provisioning logs?
Priya G.: I looked — console shows user claim completed, project created `auroradata-prod`, but provisioning service created a key under `redwood-internal-staging` project. 403 expected.
Sam H.: Ugh. Is that a mapping/routing bug or a race with the provisioner?
Liam R.: Pinged infra. Early hypothesis: provisioner used fallback project when IAM binding call to customer project timed out. I have the provisioner log excerpt: 
```
2026-02-12T14:02:11Z INFO claim received: auroradata-prod
2026-02-12T14:02:12Z WARN iam.bind timeout to project auroradata-prod (deadline exceeded)
2026-02-12T14:02:12Z INFO creating key in fallback project redwood-internal-staging id=key_01AB
```
Liam R.: That matches. The code path intentionally creates in a fallback project to avoid blocking provisioning, but we didn't surface it to the UI.
Jules K.: Customer is on a POC and needs keys ASAP. Can we rebind the key to the correct project or generate a new one and rotate?
Liam R.: Quick remediation: I can copy the key metadata into auroradata-prod and update bindings, then rotate the key. Will need a short maintenance window (~5m). Confirm?
Sam H.: Please go ahead. Also need an explanation we can send to the customer.
DeployBot: Provisioner job 3512345678-01 started by priya_g at 2026-02-12T14:03:05Z
Liam R.: Done — I created a new key in auroradata-prod (key id key_AZ9) and rotated the old key. New key is active in console for the customer's org. I also revoked key_01AB in redwood-internal-staging.
Priya G.: Verified with AuroraData — their app succeeded calling /v1/generate after replacing the key. No 403s now.
Sam H.: Thanks. Please paste the minimal postmortem notes I can send to them (short).
Liam R.: Postmortem blurb: "During SSO onboarding, the provisioning system experienced an IAM bind timeout to the customer's project and created an API key in an internal fallback project. We reprovisioned a rotated key into the correct project and revoked the fallback key. We're adding better telemetry and a hard-fail path to prevent silent fallback creations."
Priya G.: Also told them temporary remediation steps: replace key, confirm rotations, re-run tests.
Jules K.: Customer happy for now, asked for assurance this won't recur for production onboarding.
Liam R.: Action items: 1) change provisioner behavior to fail the provisioning (no silent fallback) + explicit retry (owner: eng-infra, ticket INF-2421). 2) Add UI flag/alert when keys are created in non-customer projects (owner: console, ticket CONS-1188). 3) Backfill audit: scan last 30 days for any keys in `redwood-internal-*` created during onboarding flows and notify affected customers (owner: security).
Sam H.: Please add ETA for INF-2421 and CONS-1188.
Liam R.: INF-2421: spike + PR in 3 days, rollout in 10 days. CONS-1188: spike in 5 days, rollout 12 days.
Jules K.: I'll schedule a follow-up email to AuroraData with the fix summary + invite to onboarding review.
Sam H.: Great. Thanks all. Closing thread after tickets created.
Priya G.: Created support ticket SUP-8674 for AuroraData and linked INF-2421 and CONS-1188.
Liam R.: I've uploaded the provisioning logs and the revocation evidence to the ticket.
Sam H.: Noted. Closing. :white_check_mark:
